you want a p-value for one pair of items

recommendations.why: Adds to every row its score on a rating battery: the average of its answered items or a prorated total, reverse-worded items flipped. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16) and score (f64).

alternatives.when: you want how consistently the items measure one thing
the items should be weighted by how much each reflects a common trait
you want an arbitrary formula of the items

recommendations.why: Checks whether a set of numeric fields are related at all, the first check before summarising them as a few underlying dimensions. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16) and score (f64).

you want the dimensions themselves

recommendations.why: Which hidden qualities a set of related measures reflects, and how strongly each measure is tied to each, before building scale scores. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16) and score (f64).

alternatives.when: you want summaries of all the spread, not just what the measures share
you already know the items measure one quality and want its reliability

you only want to see which measures go together, pair by pair

recommendations.why: Whether a theory of how measures hang together holds: the hidden qualities they reflect, how those drive each other, how well it fits. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16) and score (f64).

alternatives.when: you do not yet know which measures belong to which quality
every variable is measured directly and you want one outcome's drivers
you want one battery's reliability before scoring it

follow_ups.when: the fit is poor and the structure needs exploring

alternatives.when: you do not yet know which measures belong to which quality
you want the model's fit, paths and latent means rather than per-row scores
every item counts equally and you want a plain battery average
